"""Account twelve original V168 scientific owners,head calls and both parent passes."""
import json,os,time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'))
training=read(root/'status-v1.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert training['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review' and set(training['completed'])=={'smoke','train'}
assert post['status']=='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
assert set(post['completed'])=={'checkpoint-validation','review','scores','metric-audit','render'} and all(v['returncode']==0 for v in post['completed'].values())
owners=[('training-controller',training['owner'])]+[(n,read(root/f'{n}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for n in ['smoke','train']]
owners += [('postprocess-controller',post['owner'])]+[(n,v['owner']) for n,v in post['completed'].items()]
owners += [('data-inspection',read(root/'data-inspect-owner-v1.json')),('original-data-cache',read(root/'data-cache-launch-v1.json')['owner']),('parent-policy-validation',read(root/'data-parent-flag-validation-launch-v1.json')['owner'])]
original_root=Path(plan['original_failed_root']);owners += [('original-training-controller',read(original_root/'status-v1.json')['owner']),('original-training-worker',read(original_root/'train-failure-v1.json')['owner']),('original-review-queue',read(original_root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')['owner'])]
partial_review_root=Path(plan['original_partial_review_root']);partial_status=read(partial_review_root/'postprocess-status-v1.json');owners += [('failed-first-review-queue',partial_status['owner']),('failed-first-review-worker',partial_status['completed']['review']['owner'])]
assert len(owners)==len({(o['pid'],o['created']) for n,o in owners})==17
terminal=[]
for stage,owner in owners:
 assert not live(owner),(stage,owner)
 try:
  p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);state='PID-reused-original-terminal' if p.create_time()!=owner['created'] else p.status()
 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:state='absent'
 terminal.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':state})
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');assert review['component_forwards']==3288 and review['control_replayed_exact']==review['new_prediction_arrays']==1644
assert review['adopted_original_actual_forwards']==2770 and review['actual_new_component_forwards']==518
paths=set();newpaths=set();review_images=bounds=controls=0
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
 c=read(binding['path']);assert c['component_forwards']==822
 forward=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
 assert [r['returned_forwards'] for r in forward]==list(range(1,823))
 assert [json.loads(s) for s in Path(c['observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]==c['observations']
 control=c['arm']=='legacy-control';assert c['adopted_array_storage_after_actual_replay']==control
 for row in c['observations']:
  p=Path(row['prediction']['path']);assert p.is_relative_to('/mnt/external') and str(p) not in paths;paths.add(str(p))
  assert row['archive_replayed_bit_exact']==control and row['declared_support_floor']==.25
  assert .25<=row['support_minimum']<=row['support_maximum']<=1;bounds+=1;review_images+=row['inputs']['packed']['shape'][0]
  if control:controls+=1
  else:newpaths.add(str(p))
assert len(paths)==3288 and len(newpaths)==controls==1644 and bounds==3288
legacy=read(plan['cache']['path']);candidate=read(plan['candidate_cache']['path'])
recovery=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');failed=read(original_root/'train-failure-v1.json')
assert recovery['completed_overlap_updates_replayed']==165 and recovery['actual_component_forwards']=={'legacy-control':250,'fine-mesh':250}
oldrows=[json.loads(s) for s in (original_root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert len(oldrows)==915
assert recovery['trace'][:915]==oldrows
actual_new=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'resume-forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert len(actual_new)==500
for arm in ['legacy-control','fine-mesh']:assert [r['actual_returned_forwards'][arm] for r in actual_new if r['arm']==arm]==list(range(1,251))
head_calls=20+sum(failed['progress']['counts'].values())+sum(recovery['actual_component_forwards'].values())+review['component_forwards'];assert head_calls==5638
training_images=4*(sum(failed['progress']['counts'].values())+sum(recovery['actual_component_forwards'].values()));assert training_images==9320
smoke_images=80;images=training_images+smoke_images+review_images;assert images==12688
original=read(root/'data-cache-result-v1.json');validation=read(root/'data-parent-flag-validation-v1.json');inspection=read(root/'data-inspection-v1.json')
assert original['counts']=={'parent_entered':171,'parent_returned':171,'DINO_entered':171,'DINO_returned':171}
assert validation['counts']=={'parent_root':171,'DINO':171} and validation['rows_checked']==validation['different_rows']==171
assert original['inspection_inputs_adopted']==6 and original['additional_input_constructions']==165 and len(inspection['batches'])==6
returned=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'data-parent-forward-events-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(s)['event']=='returned-parent']
assert len(returned)==171 and [r['counts']['parent_returned'] for r in returned]==list(range(1,172))
checked=[json.loads(s) for s in (root/'data-parent-flag-validation-trace-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert checked==validation['observations'] and [r['counts']['parent_root'] for r in checked]==list(range(1,172))
changed=[r for r in candidate['batches'] if r['step'] in {v['step'] for v in read(root/'data-plan-v1.json')['selected']}]
assert len(changed)==171 and all(r['inspection_input_adopted']==(r['step'] in read(root/'data-plan-v1.json')['inspection_steps']) for r in changed)
poisson=sum(r['metadata']['actual_sampler_calls']['sensor_Poisson'] for r in changed);gaussian=sum(r['metadata']['actual_sampler_calls']['sensor_Gaussian'] for r in changed)
assert (poisson,gaussian)==(513,171)
excluded={os.getpid()}|{p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()};matching=[]
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
 if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:continue
 if any(s==str(root) or s.startswith(str(root)+'/') for s in p.info['cmdline'] or []):matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching,matching
output=root/'execution-completion-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'all17-original-recovery-and-review-continuation-owners-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'recorded_owner_count':17,'owners':terminal,
 'head_calls':head_calls,'main_head_calls':head_calls,'head_image_evaluations':images,'main_head_images':images,
 'training_head_images':training_images,'smoke_head_images':smoke_images,'review_head_images':review_images,
 'actual_parent_root_calls':342,'actual_DINO_backbone_calls':342,'parent_image_evaluations':1368,'DINO_image_evaluations':1368,
 'total_top_level_model_roots':5980,'total_top_level_model_images':14056,'logical_head_calls':5308,'logical_head_images':11368,'parity_leaf_backwards':0,'new_compatibility_head_roots':0,'motivation_root_calls':0,
 'new_input_batches_constructed':171,'new_training_observations_constructed':684,'source_recipe_render_evaluations':684,'geometry_transforms':684,
 'new_sensor_sampler_calls':684,'Poisson_calls':poisson,'Gaussian_calls':gaussian,'coupled_sensor_calls':171,
 'unchanged_legacy_batches_adopted':829,'inspected_input_batches_adopted':6,'additional_input_constructions':165,
 'scientific_stage_failures':2,'dependent_controller_failures':3,'review_policy_corrections':1,'review_continuations':1,'review_forwards_adopted':2770,'review_continuation_new_forwards':518,'full_training_restarts':0,'checkpoint_resumptions':1,'overlap_steps_replayed_per_head':165,'additional_recovery_head_forwards':330,'parent_setup_corrections':1,'read_only_preparation_verifier_failures':1,
 'review_root_calls':3288,'control_prediction_replays_exact':1644,'new_prediction_arrays':1644,'review_support_bound_records':bounds,
 'new_array_bytes':sum(Path(p).stat().st_size for p in newpaths),'corrected_parent_arrays':171,
 'original_cache':ref(root/'data-cache-result-v1.json'),'parent_policy_validation':ref(root/'data-parent-flag-validation-v1.json'),
 'canonical_candidate_cache':plan['candidate_cache'],'training_completion':ref(root/'status-v1.json'),'postprocess_completion':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
 'unit_and_mask_audit':ref(root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json'),'actual_training_objective_and_bounds':ref(root/'training-objective-audit-v1.json'),
 'live_matching_root_argv':matching,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
